about.title: About us
about.description: negocio.com.py is Paraguay's business directory: fast, warm and trustworthy.
about.heading: Paraguay's business directory
about.p1: negocio.com.py exists to connect people with the local businesses in their neighbourhood and their city. We think finding a good restaurant, a workshop you can trust or a professional near you should be simple, fast and free.
about.p2: We bring businesses from across the country together — from Asunción to Encarnación, from Ciudad del Este to Luque — in one place, with the information that actually matters: how to reach them, where they are and when they open.
about.p3: For businesses, we are an honest way to gain visibility and win customers. No inflated promises and no fake reviews: we show what is real.
